Decouple runner from UI implementation details

The WorkflowRunner was directly instantiating BivvyTheme for text
formatting and reaching through SpinnerHandle to get an indicatif
ProgressBar. Both bypassed the UserInterface trait abstraction.

runner asks the UI to format text instead of doing it directly. Replace

indicatif dependency stays encapsulated inside the spinner module.

The runner no longer imports anything from ui::theme or ui::spinner.
EOF

    SpinnerHandle::progress_bar() with create_output_callback() so the
    indicatif dependency stays encapsulated inside the spinner module.
